segments.ja240:1.1: Sabbo jano hiṃsito piṅgalena, tasmiṃ mate paccayā [paccayaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] vedayanti;
segments.ja240:1.3: Piyo nu te āsi akaṇhanetto, kasmā nu tvaṃ rodasi dvārapāla.
segments.ja240:2.1: Na me piyo āsi akaṇhanetto, bhāyāmi paccāgamanāya tassa;
segments.ja240:2.3: Ito gato hiṃseyya maccurājaṃ, so hiṃsito āneyya puna idha.
segments.ja240:3.3: Parikkhatā ca sā bhūmi, mā bhāyi nāgamissatīti.
